verdict.for_whom: This is for groups of friends seeking a spooky, cooperative investigation game who do not mind learning complex mechanics, but not for solo players or those who expect a bug-free virtual reality experience.

distortion_flags.sentence: Satisfaction rises after the initial hours of play but experiences a steep decline among players who have logged the highest playtime.
Recent reviews show a drop in positivity compared to the historical sentiment.

cohorts.label: <2h refund window
cohorts.summary: Players who stop playing early report bugs in the tutorial, connection issues in multiplayer, and difficulty gathering ghost evidence.

claims.claim: Reviewers report difficulty gathering ghost evidence during matches, stating that evidence fails to show up or ghosts do not interact.

citations.review_text: Buggy game, thats mainly just waiting for something to happen. Played with freinds and all 5-6 rounds we played best we ever got one a SINGLE evidnce even tho each run was over 15 min. ONly buy if your ok with waiting and kinda boring and very repetitive gameplay

i have less than one hour on the game and it sucks everything is bugged items don't work right ghost evidence does not show up for some reason. the animations are so bad and take up 90 percent your screen one of the worst games i have played don't buy they need to do some serious work to make the game playable.

Me and friends wanted a fun game to play together, and two of them already had this game because they played it a while ago. Me and another friend bought it, expecting it to be good because it's super popular and stuck around all this time. We try to make a lobby, but after some issues we have to restart and make a new lobby. Then, me and another friend have an issue connecting to the new lobby where it would infinitely try to connect us but it would never go through, so the lobby needed to be restarted again and we needed to relaunch the game. Then, we all get in, but for some reason there's this cork board menu that pops up when you press spacebar, and pressing "leave" doesn't exit the board, it exits the entire lobby. After mistakenly pressing the button, I have to get another invite, then I get hit with ANOTHER infinite connecting glitch, and I have to relaunch the game again. Finally we ready up and go into the game.

The game sucked, we couldn't get any evidence because the ghost would never interact, so it was just us walking through the house and waiting for something to happen. Controls are frustratingly bad, the game looks horrible, it runs like an unoptimized triple A game, the menu is janky to navigate, it's boring, and everything is just slow and aggravating. It's as if more effort was put into trying to capture the un-polished charm of the game when it got popular than was put into fixing all of its actual issues.

If you are like me, seeking out a fun friendslop co-op game to play over discord, do not make my mistake and buy this game because it used to be popular. Instead, I would suggest a game like REPO, which is so much more polished, smooth to control, and fun overall.

cohorts.label: 2-20h
cohorts.summary: Players in this group find the game is highly cooperative and best played with friends, though they note a steep learning curve, slow progression, unstable virtual reality support, and various bugs like item clipping and performance stuttering.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features a complex and steep learning curve with unclear mechanics, requiring players to consult external guides or complete tutorials to understand core systems.

citations.review_text:
Fun in theory!
I really enjoy the concept of this game, there being a supernatural entity and having to follow clues to determine exactly what it is so that it can be eliminated. that's a fun idea!
Where this game lets me down is in its execution. More often than not contact with the supernatural will result in either a swift death, or will be so subtle that its possible to not even notice anything. 
The real struggle with this game is quite possibly its lack of any proper tutorial or training, rather it just drops players into the deep end with very little equipment to help. This just only ever results in myself and my friends struggling to laugh off repeated failures with seemingly little progress made towards any sort of goal.
There are a litany of unclear and unexplained mechanics to how the spirits and hunting them actually works, i think with a little better explanation and more ways to work together this game could be a lot of fun. As for right now it simply falls short.

Played the game for 15 hours and I still feel as though I know nothing about the game. All the ghosts have secret tells that allow you to identify them that aren't stated (to my knowledge) anywhere in the game. If you are playing on high difficulties you end up not knowing at all how to identify the ghost and end up dying because you don't know how to loop the ghost. Lower difficulties are better, but some parts of them are too forgiving and none of them really feel like a perfect medium. Never mind the fact that the game is (in my opinion) not fun unless you are playing with friends or fun randoms. If you are willing to sink an hour into youtube to learn advanced mechanics and many more hours into the game to develop skills based on the mechanics than by all means, buy this game. If you don't have friends to play with I would not bother with this though.

The game does start out complicated and there is a lot to learn if you don't play someone who knows the ropes or have previously watched someone play it (absolutely do the tutorial if your totally new! Apparently only 6% of players complete it per the Steam achievements lol).

Each ghost has it's own nuances and special events meaning each encounter is mostly unique, especially between haunting locations. I feel like there is always something new to learn for casual players, meaning your nearly always on your toes during playthroughs.

This is incredibly fun to play with friends! The reason I bought this was specifically for the multiplayer (I only play with people I know, so I cannot speak for the public lobbies). Solo is a lot more intense and scary for me personally, whereas with friends you get a lot more interesting ghost interactions, funny moments and the game is easier to learn how to play alongside others. Solo or not, it can be a decent challenge in harder modes and still retain its spooky factor even after many hours of playing. The auditory and visual jump-scares still get me even when I know what to expect.

Overall, pretty fun and spooky-scary! Way more awesome with friends! :)

claims.claim: Reviewers encounter navigation and interaction problems in the environment, such as difficulty picking up objects positioned near furniture and ghosts killing players through closets used as hiding spots.

citations.review_text:
[h2] Damn, this game is such a broken mess. [/h2]  
It's been six years since it was "released" on Steam, and it still feels like i'm playing some kind of alpha build 
[i] (Meanwhile, Voices of the Void doesn't give me that feeling at all, even though it's literally in alpha). 
[/i]

[h3] And the recent update... [/h3]
♥♥♥♥, even nuking the graphics settings didn't help. The game just stutters and freezes constantly. My friend I was playing with had the exact same issues too- i was in VR, he was on PC. 
[b] How the ♥♥♥♥ is [u] THIS GAME [/u] even lagging? [/b]

[h3] And don't even get me started on the awful interaction with the environment. [/h3]
VR is one thing- it's a niche platform, so I can understand it not getting as much attention. But when you're playing on PC and can't pick up a laser projector because it fell between a cabinet and a vacuum cleaner? That's complete ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥. You can line up your cursor pixel-perfect, and [b] [u] YOU STILL WON'T BE ABLE TO PICK IT UP [/u] [/b].

Desync is basically the norm too. The items I place on the floor are constantly in completely different spots for other players.

[b] I honestly don't even know how to recommend this game. It's horribly broken, unpolished, and just plain janky. 
Sure, you can have a good time playing it with friends- but only for one evening. By the next day, it feels like you went on an all-night drinking binge, and nobody wants to go through that again lol [/b]
It is fun and a great game, but im confused I thought closets were supposed to be hiding spots during a hunt but the ghosts will kill me through them anyway

claims.claim: Reviewers state that recent updates reworked classic maps and changed features in ways that negatively impacted the game.

citations.review_text:
Good game with a unique concept that's ruined by incompetent devs

I decided to rebuy this game on steam and play it again after they released the cosmetic update but it almost completely ruined the game. In addition to all the awful changes they've made the game is also extremely buggy.

A list of random bugs ive found in the 10 ish hours ive played since the update:

-Picking up two flashlights breaks your inventory, making you unable to pick up items
-if playing with a console player through crossplay and they try to use the computer in the truck it will crash their game
-Random Graphical error's and parts of the map not loading while walking though even on a good pc (5070ti, 9800X3D, 32GBDDR5)
-Turning the parabolic mic on and switching items without turning it off sometimes permanently muffles audio until you restart your game
-When attempting to exit the house right as the ghost starts a hunt you can become stuck in the front door
- Ghost hit box can be extremely disjointed, sometimes killing you from comically far away, even while crouching
-General connection and stability problems. (host dc'ing, people not being able to join, ect)
-Photo camera taking pictures even when youre not holding it
-The radio can randomly stop working requiring a game restart to fix
-Voice chat can randomly stop working requiring a restart to fix
-Night Vision mode on the T3 video camera not working on some maps
-CCTV not working on some maps
-Cursed object not spawning or being invisible 
-Items randomly becoming impossible to interact with 
-Brightness randomly changing for no reason

These were just off the top of my head and only the ones that I personally encountered.

A good game at its core but its seriously scuffed in its current state

I started playing this game a few years ago, I peaked playtime around 2 years ago when it had released on console, i played and platinumed it on ps5 and it was an amazing game at the time. However over time they have made changes that no one has asked for, such as reworking all of the classic maps that we all loved, making the game needlessly harder, and the fact that it has been in early access for nearly six years. I stopped playing right around the time that the tangle wood rework came out; I tried it, didn't like it, tried other reworked maps and didn't like them either, and it had me thinking: "Who actually asked for this?" Well, no one did. I guess Kinetic just decided that the game that was working for so many thousands of people, just wasn't working for them, which isn't how it works. You don't make a Movie, see that people like it but realize you don't and just get rid of the movie and film it differently. Personally i don't see myself playing this game again until they bring back the original things to the game that we all loved before.

This game used to be so much fun with friends but with the recent update they've just ruined it. Reworking maps that don't need it instead of creating new ones, ruined the equipment animations the list goes on. before the update i would recommend this any day of the week but now this game is un playable and is not install on my pc or my Xbox

claims.claim: Reviewers note that recent updates introduced significant performance issues, including stuttering, lag, and sharp drops in framerate.

citations.review_text:
If I had made this review before the huge customization/rework update, I would have absolutely recommended, ENCOURAGED even, to get this game because it's silly fun and it was a good way to pass the time. WAS.

I don't know what they did in the update to make the game perform like this, but since the update has been out, my game has been nothing but a buggy and stuttering mess that's been awful to play. I really thought it was just some of my specs that was making the game run this way, but no, plenty of people are having this same problem (which in a way made me feel very vindicated). I do not know why the developers are even trying to rework some of the early maps that really don't need to be reworked on, considering they ran just fine before this update, but not try to fix some of the stuttering issues a bunch of people are encountering right now.

As a fan of this game, it really hurts to say this, but I cannot support a game that is continuing to make baffling decisions that'll inevitably lead to its downfall. Until they fix or remove these updates entirely, please spend your money elsewhere or, and I can't believe I'm even typing this out, play the Roblox version of this game. At least then, it won't bug out for majority of the playtime.
super fun with friends very silly but the new character update makes it very laggy anf fps drops

claims.claim: Reviewers state that player animations and character models appear stiff, choppy, or broken.

citations.review_text: Janky, crashes frequently, animations and player models are broken and buggy. Devs make excuses and tell players to 'get used to the jank', then proceed to buy fake reviews to try looking less terrible. Will update when they start fixing this game, which has been out for 6 years now and isn't any less buggy.

I have a lot of hours in this game for someone who doesn't enjoy it, but I really just don't think it's very fun or particularly replayable. If you, like me, do not find ghosts remotely scary as a concept then that immediately takes away from the fun because that is the entire scaffolding of this game. I have spent 50 hours with various friends and all enjoyment I've had has come from seeing them get scared by stuff, but unlike similar games like Lethal Company (which despite being a comedy game can be very scary at times) very few stressful or isolating things happen during gameplay that can really cause any kind of fear response after you've seen a hunt the first time, because yes, each ghost has different properties and things that make them mad, but they all kill you the same way.
 
Also, because the gameplay is entirely knowledge based, it makes playing with both new players as an experienced player and experienced players as a new player completely unfun, because either everyone else knows exactly what to do and it's just routine to them, or you know exactly what to do and the others will just get killed. 

Finally, I think the realism entirely falls flat when you have a mostly realistic looking game but all of your buddies are kind of like human mannequins who awkwardly bend at 90 degree angles to look at stuff and run super stuffly. Because they've committed to making the game realistic, everything that doesn't seem realistic immediately pulls me out of whatever tension the game is trying to create. I would much rather a game that looks visually consistent and old than visually all over the place, go back to Silent Hill 2 and tell me that game doesn't evoke some kind of discomfort just by looking at it. It's not particularly realistic looking for the modern age, but the visual style is so entirely cohesive that the brain doesn't give a ♥♥♥♥.

So, I don't think the gameplay is very fun OR scary, I don't think it has much replay value, and I think the way the …
I really liked the consistent coding especially for the complicated ghosts like the kormos and obambo. The animation can be a bit choppy at times but thats what is so charming about this game :)

claims.claim: Recent updates are described as altering ghost behaviors incorrectly, such as Obakes failing to shapeshift and Goryos moving away from their assigned rooms.

citations.review_text:
Honestly? Really great game, only issue are the bugs. During the new Willow Rework updates. For some reason, the ghosts tend to bug, Obake's not shapeshifting, Goryo's moving all over the place. And cosmetic bugs that came along with the new characterization update. Multiplayer lobbies you usually have a BLAST. But, sometimes you run into rude people, modders, and some other things.

IN GOOBER TERMS : 

NGL Phasmophobia is straight up peak gameplay if you love screaming your lungs out in a dark basement, but the ghosts are acting super goofy right now fr fr. Ever since the Willow rework and characterization updates dropped, the game is kinda a hot mess of bugs. Obakes literally forgot how to shapeshift, Goryos are doing full-on marathons around the house when they're supposed to stay in their room, and the visual glitches make everyone look like walking sleep paralysis demons. It’s honestly hilarious watching a ghost completely break the rules just to mess with your head.

Multiplayer lobbies are usually an absolute BLAST where you and your low-sanity squad bond over getting hunted, but public matches can be a total roulette wheel. claims.claim: Reviewers note that recent updates introduced various bugs and performance issues, such as desync, stuttering, and items vibrating or falling through floors.

citations.review_text:
Not Recommended

I've spent a good amount of time with Phasmophobia, and while the core concept is still excellent, I can't recommend it in its current state. This review isn't meant to attack the developers—they've clearly put a lot of work into the game—but many long-standing issues continue to frustrate a large part of the player base.

The biggest problem is the slow pace of meaningful updates. New content often takes a long time to arrive, while long-requested features and quality-of-life improvements remain unfinished. Roadmaps have shifted multiple times, making it difficult to know when promised features will actually be released.

Performance and optimization are another concern. Even on capable hardware, players frequently report inconsistent frame rates, stuttering, and longer loading times than expected. Performance can also vary significantly between updates.

The progression system has become more grind-heavy than it used to be. Unlocking equipment and progressing through prestige can feel repetitive, especially for experienced players who already understand the game's mechanics. Instead of encouraging experimentation, progression sometimes feels like an unnecessary barrier.

Equipment balancing also remains inconsistent. Some items feel far more useful than others, leaving certain tools rarely worth bringing. This reduces variety and can make loadouts feel repetitive.

Multiplayer still has its share of frustrations. Public lobbies can be unreliable, disconnects still happen, and there are occasional synchronization issues that affect the investigation experience. Since the game is built around cooperative play, these problems have a noticeable impact.

Another common criticism is communication. While the developers do share information, updates on long-term goals, delays, and priorities are often too vague. Players are left waiting without a clear understanding of what is happening behind the scenes.

The game also suffers from a lack of long-term re…

After having been one of the people to quit due to the bugs and problems with the character customization update, I was very hesitant to try the Willow rework update. That said, with a hopeful heart I gave it a chance and was hoping for honestly less than I got. I just wanted the game to feel playable again but instead it was actually FUN again... There's still some bugs (mostly cosmetic at this point) like items vibrating in/out of existence or falling through the floor (make sure you set equipment on tables if playing with friends to try and avoid losing items) and animations being a little bit awkward still- but it's way way way better than it was and the other fixes/changes (like the better lightning) make that game MUCH better and worthy of another chance.

If you're reading this wondering if you should come back, do it. Give the game another chance. Hopefully they keep going down this path and don't make me regret being hopeful xD

citations.review_text: Loved this game. Countless nights of dropping into Phasmo. Had some amazing times. Great game at its core. But the devs spend most of their time 'reworking' and replacing all the maps that players love instead of making new small maps. One of the things this game needed was more small maps. The large maps are awful to play. Stop replacing the original maps. I understand you're making them more atmospheric, and I'll give credit where it's due. They do a pretty good job of it. But I've been playing this game since launch, and love the OG maps. Even with their many update iterations done over time. But just make new maps. Consider a selection page so players can choose to select the version of the maps before you updated them. This would also double the maps. It could be like 14 Tanglewood, and 17 Tanglewood. Same house model, BUT DIFFERENT maps. Similar to what you did with the campgrounds. Took the OG, then made a different, smaller playable version of it. DO THAT INSTEAD OF REPLACING ALL THE OG MAPS. They've changed the UI like 3 times, and left the current one, which is awful. Looks like they're finally working on custom characters after 6 years of everyone begging for it. About time. But they'll likely botch it. Death animations is something that should have been done years ago as well. Your priorities are completely out to lunch. Everytime we come to revisit Phasmo, another map we love is replaced. Regretfully, me and my group of friends are done with phasmo.

I hate to say this but every recent update has ruined the game ever since.

- My biggest complain from Phasmophobia is all of the bugs (I started playing in late 2023) that still haven't been fixed, and most of the bugs FROM 2023 ARE STILL IN THE GAME. I get that this game is still early access and hopefully, all of the major bugs / bugs the community has been wishing to be fixed wouldn't be a problem anymore, but still my point still stands that you had 3 ENTIRE YEARS to address game breaking bugs, or several map issues and clipping issues, but you decide not to. Instead, you decide to add a random feature that nobody asked for, or delay one of your most ANTICIPATED UPDATES, THE HORROR 2.0, SEVERAL TIMES. It's gotten to the point where the player base has ever since forgotten about it, or just entirely think you've scrapped the update.

- The character customization update + the recent map reworks have wiped away any charm the game previously had. I get that willow street, edge field and tanglewood all looked similar, but you could've at least re-skinned the respective maps instead of mostly re-arranging the whole layout. You also could've added a "Legacy map" option, allowing for older players to still have an enjoyable time on their favorite maps.

- A lot of the new ghosts after the December 2025 update either felt too repetitive, or just took one very niche ability, recycle said ability for another ghost, and called it a day. It gets to the point where if you think a ghost is a totally different ghost, but turns out to be the other ghost, because for some dumb reason, the two are identical.
